01 / THE REALITYA national challenge. A human story.

Closer to home
than you might think.

Heart disease touches families in every corner of America. Understanding its impact is the first step toward changing it.

1 in 5*

U.S. deaths are caused
by heart disease.

Heart disease All other causes1 person = 1%

*A rounded estimate of the share of deaths, not the share of people living with heart disease. CDC, 2022.

02 / KNOW THE NUMBERS

A clearer picture.
A better starting point.

Heart disease and its risk factors aren't the same thing. Explore the difference, and see who is most affected.

03 / CHANGE THE STORY

Small steps.
Stronger hearts.

You don't have to change everything overnight. A few everyday choices can help protect the heart that keeps you going.

A little progress is still progress.

High blood pressure often has no symptoms. Ask a healthcare professional what your blood pressure and cholesterol numbers mean, and how often to check them.
